text:
marta: quick follow-up after the canary — we observed orphaned provisional leases when client retries hit after a finalizer timeout. want quick agreement on a safe short-term fix.

jp: saw ~0.6% token delta for one tenant. repro is retry without stable request_id.

sai: can you outline failure steps?

marta: 1) edge creates provisional lease id, 2) prefix cache returns tokens, 3) finalizer RPC times out during commit, 4) client retries -> new lease created, original provisional left PROVISIONAL.

oliver: tl;dr duplicate charges + orphan rows.

jp: short-term options: (A) add composite dedupe key for finalizer, (B) delay provisional until finalization (higher latency), (C) run TTL-based reconcilier that emits correction events.

sai: dedupe key helpful but SDKs sometimes omit request_id. composite key = tenant+session+prefix_fp+req_fp seems workable.

ingest-bot: deploy-note: meter-finalizer v2 canary rolled 3m ago.

marta: propose: keep provisional for now, add audit tag and reconcilier job that lists provisionals older than default 5m, attempts to fetch final event, and if missing emits a correction envelope into billing. correction envelope example as a single-line JSON string: {"type":"correction","orig_lease_id":"uuid","tenant":"t-123","delta_tokens":"-120","reason":"orphaned_after_5m"}.

jp: rule: if correction exists, later finalization is a no-op. add metrics: provisional_count, orphan_count, corrections_emitted, finalizations_after_correction. tenant TTL should be configurable.

sai: add synthetic test for delayed finalization to avoid over-refunds.

oliver: long-term: consider avoiding provisional leases for prefix-only cached responses; separate RFC.

marta: action items: jp draft finalizer change + correction envelope spec (2d), sai add dashboards + alert on orphan_rate >0.1% (3d), oliver simulation of composite dedupe key on 7d traffic (1w). i'll open PR.

jp: +1

sai: +1

oliver: +1 :thumbsup:

marta: closing thread, will tag everyone on the PR.
